item.title: 14 Arcade Games That Emptied Our Pockets in the ‘80s and ‘90s
item.description: Before microtransactions and battle passes, there was the quarter. Arcade cabinets ruled malls, pizza joints, boardwalks, and movie theatre lobbies throughout the 1980s and 1990s. Bright marquees, attract screens, and booming speakers were engineered to pull you in, while ruthless difficulty curves were designed to keep the coins flowing. item.title: 15 Video Games That Were Way Ahead of Their Time
item.description: Long before MMO open worlds became standard, certain titles were already experimenting with ideas the industry would only fully embrace years later. Whether because of hardware limitations, market timing, or audience expectations, these games were not always appreciated at launch. Looking back now however, it is clear they were building tomorrow’s design philosophy long before the rest of the industry caught up.
